newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's Kia drops Samsung complaint.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's Kia drops Samsung complaint.

text.p: The ailing Kia Group, South Korea's eighth largest conglomerate, said on Friday it had dropped its complaint against Samsung Motors for leaking a report alleging managerial problems at Kia.
"We dropped our complaints against Samsung on Wednesday because we now have more pressing work to do," said a Kia spokesman.
In June, Kia lodged a complaint to prosecutors against Samsung Motors for disseminating false information about Kia.
Kia said Samsung argued in an internal report that confidence in Kia's top managers had been lost and Kia faced "internal managerial conflicts".
Kia, which is now under protection from its creditors, said the contents of the report were groundless and its release was "unintentional".
Domestic media reported prosecutors ruled the leak was not intentional.
Samsung Motor officials said Samsung would issue an official statement on the matter on Saturday.

Samsung has never admitted its ambition to take over Kia, but industry analysts said Samsung would be interested in such a deal because it would greatly help Samsung's expansion into the car industry.
